user.title: Continue with ChatGPT
user.description: Run scripts/chatgpt_login.py on the computer running your browser. Sign in to ChatGPT and authorize plan usage, then paste the protected credential file JSON here. Use HTTPS to access Home Assistant. Credentials are saved locally by Home Assistant. See the installation guide for details.

model.title: Choose a ChatGPT model
model.description: Models come from your account. Device access starts disabled. Enable it later in the integration options.

error.invalid_auth: Credentials are invalid, expired, or lack ChatGPT plan permissions. Run the sign-in helper again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to OpenAI. Check internet access and try again.
error.no_models: No eligible models returned. Check ChatGPT account and workspace permissions.

abort.already_configured: This account registration is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same ChatGPT account and issued client ID.

settings.title: ChatGPT Assist options
settings.description: Device control grants the built-in Assist API access to exposed entities. Review Settings → Voice assistants → Expose before enabling. Exposed scripts can have broader effects. Configuration administration is separate, disabled by default, and restricted to authenticated administrators. Grant exact targets as comma-separated lists. Review changes before applying.

data.control: Allow reading and controlling exposed entities
data.administration: Enable configuration inspection and drafts (administrators only)
data.automation_ids: Allowed automation configuration IDs (comma separated; new IDs allow creation)
data.dashboard_paths: Allowed existing storage dashboard URL paths (comma separated; <default> for the legacy default)

review.title: Select a configuration proposal
review.description: Select a draft to review, or select an applied/failed proposal and enable Restore to review its saved backup. Drafts expire after 30 minutes. Applying changes can affect your home.

data.rollback: Restore saved backup instead of applying the draft

confirm.title: Review configuration changes

data.approve: I have reviewed the configuration and approve this operation

error.cannot_connect: Could not refresh the account model list. The existing model is shown.
error.administration_failed: The operation could not be completed. See the explanation above.

abort.no_proposals: No saved proposals are available. Ask the assistant to prepare a configuration change first.
abort.configuration_applied: Configuration applied. Automations were reloaded if applicable.
